intro: Hi, I'm Ramadan, a university student in Nigeria, and I built StockPilot.
problem: Stocks are coming onchain and trade around the clock. An AI could manage them, but to trade, it needs your keys, and one bug or prompt injection can drain you.
idea: So I built StockPilot: an AI autopilot that can only trade inside the rules you sign. A vault you own checks every trade.
guard: Even if the pilot is hacked, it can't withdraw, can't change your rules, can't pile into one stock, and can't take a bad price.
theater: It's live on Robinhood Chain testnet. Anyone can fire nine attacks at the real contract with the pilot's own key, and every one is refused.
whyme: Why me? I care about making AI safe to trust with real money, and I shipped this end to end: the contracts, the pilot, the app, and around three hundred tests.
business: Owners pay their pilot a small fee onchain, pilots compete in an open marketplace, and wallets and brokerages can embed it.
cta: Try it live, no wallet needed. Give an AI your portfolio, not your keys.
